en_US.title: Manual Bilge Pump Kit
en_US.scanner: Manual pump kit. Slow, ugly, reliable; the first lesson is that powered systems lie.
en_US.field_note: First tool must teach survival before upgrade fantasy.
en_US.terminal: P-63 FIELD ISSUE: hand bilge pump, hose clamp, intake screen, check valve. Use before energizing flooded panels.
en_US.audio: Hand work first. Electricity second. Breathing always.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The first tool chain starts with a manual bilge pump kit. It lets the player clear a small flooded space without trusting broken power. This anchors the opening in work: air, water level, hand force, valves and patience before any heroic cutting.
en_US.external_site: Manual Bilge Pump Kit defines the first survival verb of HECTON-8. It is intentionally humble: a hard-sci-fi tutorial object that makes pressure work tactile.

ru_RU.title: Ручной bilge pump kit
ru_RU.scanner: Manual pump kit. Медленно, грязно, надежно; первый урок в том, что powered systems лгут.
ru_RU.field_note: Первый инструмент должен учить survival до фантазии апгрейда.
ru_RU.terminal: P-63 FIELD ISSUE: hand bilge pump, hose clamp, intake screen, check valve. Use before energizing flooded panels.
ru_RU.audio: Сначала ручная работа. Потом электричество. Дыхание всегда.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Первая цепочка инструментов начинается с manual bilge pump kit. Он дает игроку очистить маленькое затопленное пространство, не доверяя сломанному питанию. Это заземляет opening в работе: воздух, уровень воды, усилие рук, клапаны и терпение до героической резки.
ru_RU.external_site: Ручной bilge pump kit задает первый survival verb HECTON-8. Он намеренно скромный: hard-sci-fi tutorial object, делающий pressure work тактильной.

en_US.title: Cold Sealant Patch Gun
en_US.scanner: Patch gun. Rated for pinholes, not miracles.
en_US.field_note: Sealant repairs should buy time, not erase pressure.
en_US.terminal: PATCH LIMIT: cold sealant cartridge bonds under wet low-depth pressure. Do not apply to active shear cracks, warm blue-debt bloom or moving cable seams.
en_US.audio: A patch is not safety. It is a countdown that looks solid.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The cold sealant patch gun is the second opening tool. It fixes small leaks, stabilizes the capsule and teaches limits. The player learns that every repair has a rating, and HECTON-8 punishes repairs used outside that rating.
en_US.external_site: Cold Sealant Patch Gun turns engineering horror into readable gameplay. It gives the player agency while preserving pressure as a constant threat.

en_US.title: Low-Power Induction Cutter
en_US.scanner: Induction cutter. Opens work metal; overheats on pressure glass and bad faith.
en_US.field_note: The cutter should feel valuable because it is limited.
en_US.terminal: TOOL WARNING: induction cutter rated for service hatches, panel bolts and light frame members. Pressure-glass lattice requires anneal or later tool class.
en_US.audio: Cut the hatch. Do not cut the thing holding the room together.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The low-power induction cutter gives the first deliberate opening action: a jammed hatch, a panel bolt, a salvage crate. It cannot solve every barrier. Pressure glass, active load-bearing frames and Atlas-grown seams demand later knowledge.
en_US.external_site: Low-Power Induction Cutter is the first controlled access tool. It turns exploration into engineering choice rather than universal door removal.

ru_RU.title: Low-power induction cutter
ru_RU.scanner: Induction cutter. Открывает work metal; перегревается на pressure glass и плохой вере.
ru_RU.field_note: Cutter должен ощущаться ценным именно потому, что он ограничен.
ru_RU.terminal: TOOL WARNING: induction cutter rated for service hatches, panel bolts and light frame members. Pressure-glass lattice requires anneal or later tool class.
ru_RU.audio: Режь hatch. Не режь то, что держит комнату целой.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Low-power induction cutter дает первое deliberate opening action: заевший hatch, panel bolt, salvage crate. Он не решает каждый barrier. Pressure glass, active load-bearing frames и Atlas-grown seams требуют позднего знания.
ru_RU.external_site: Low-power induction cutter - первый controlled access tool. Он превращает exploration в engineering choice, а не universal door removal.

en_US.title: Acoustic Pinger Line
en_US.scanner: Pinger spool. The first map is a sound you can still find when light fails.
en_US.terminal: RETURN LINE: anchor pinger before crossing turbidity, brine shimmer or flooded service elbow. Carrier handshake requires later relay spine.
en_US.audio: When the light is gone, follow the sound you had the discipline to place.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The acoustic pinger line is the first navigation discipline. It teaches the player to mark return routes, not just chase POIs. Later escape systems grow from the same idea: acoustic relays, timing, carrier handshakes and route confidence.
en_US.external_site: Acoustic Pinger Line turns HECTON-8 exploration into procedure. It is both tool and tone: a small sound against a large ocean.

en_US.title: P-63 Field Fabricator
en_US.scanner: Field fabricator. Not a magic printer: it accepts dirty inputs and gives rated parts.
en_US.field_note: Crafting starts as repair certification, not loot dopamine.
en_US.terminal: FAB P-63: approved first recipes: valve gasket, cutter contact, pinger float, sealant clamp. Rejects unknown blue-debt fragments without pressure certification.
en_US.audio: The machine can make parts. It cannot make permission.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Shallow Annex P-63 contains the first field fabricator. It should feel industrial, constrained and useful. Early recipes are valve gaskets, cutter contacts, pinger floats and sealant clamps. The fabricator refuses dangerous pressure material until the player earns containment knowledge.
en_US.external_site: P-63 Field Fabricator anchors HECTON-8 crafting in certification. Crafting is not generic alchemy; it is rated repair under pressure.
